    "Initial learning curve made the product overwhelming at first.",

  "overall_experience": "This Software Development Engineer found Smartsheet to be a highly functional tool for managing spreadsheets and project tasks within their large organization. While there was an initial learning curve, the product ultimately proved user-friendly for project management and offered strong reliability.
